faith.pick: Which faith is {label} a sacred place of?
faith.match: Match each sacred place to its faith.
faith.odd: Three of these sacred places belong to {value}. Which one doesn't?

rows.label: Basilica and Expiatory Church of the Holy Family
rows.description: basilica under construction since 1882 in Barcelona, Spain
rows.hook: has been under construction for well over a century, with spires designed by Antoni Gaudí

rows.label: Pantheon
rows.description: ancient Roman temple in Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is topped by a huge unreinforced concrete dome with a circular opening at the very top

rows.label: Cologne Cathedral
rows.description: Roman-Catholic cathedral in Cologne, Germany
rows.hook: has twin Gothic spires and took centuries to finish, yet survived heavy WWII bombing

rows.label: St. Peter's Basilica
rows.description: church in Vatican City
rows.hook: is topped by a dome designed by Michelangelo and is the largest church in Christendom

rows.label: Leaning Tower of Pisa
rows.description: cathedral bell tower in Pisa, Italy
rows.hook: famously tilts because the soft ground beneath it gave way while it was going up

rows.label: Notre-Dame de Paris
rows.description: cathedral in Paris
rows.hook: is a Gothic landmark with gargoyles, made famous by a Victor Hugo novel about a bell-ringer

rows.label: St Paul's Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral in the City of London, England, UK
rows.hook: was rebuilt by Christopher Wren after the Great Fire and hosted Charles and Diana's wedding

rows.label: Florence Cathedral
rows.description: 13th-century cathedral in Florence, Italy
rows.hook: is crowned by Brunelleschi's enormous red-tiled dome

rows.label: Sistine Chapel
rows.description: chapel in the Apostolic Palace, Vatican City
rows.hook: has a ceiling painted by Michelangelo and hosts the secret election of new popes

rows.label: Harmandir Sahib
rows.description: Sikh religious site in Amritsar, Punjab, India
rows.hook: is a gold-covered shrine floating in a sacred pool, known to outsiders as the Golden Temple

rows.label: Al-Masjid Al-Haram
rows.description: Islam's holiest mosque in Mecca, Saudi Arabia
rows.hook: surrounds the Kaaba, the black cube toward which Muslims worldwide face to pray

rows.label: Milan Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral church of Milan, Italy
rows.hook: is a huge Gothic marble landmark with thousands of statues and a rooftop you can walk on

rows.label: Sacré-Cœur
rows.description: Roman Catholic church in Paris, France
rows.hook: is a gleaming white-domed church perched on the summit of Montmartre

rows.label: St. Basil's Cathedral
rows.description: church in Moscow
rows.hook: has multicolored onion domes and stands at the edge of Red Square

rows.label: Prophet's Mosque
rows.description: mosque in Medina, Saudi Arabia
rows.hook: is where Muhammad is buried, beneath a famous green dome

rows.label: Lincoln Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral located in Lincoln in England
rows.hook: was the tallest building in the world for centuries until its central spire toppled in a storm

rows.label: Sultan Ahmed Mosque
rows.description: historic mosque located in Istanbul, Turkey, also known as Blue Mosque
rows.hook: is nicknamed for the blue tiles lining its interior and has six slender minarets

rows.label: Basilica of Our Lady of Peace of Yamoussoukro
rows.description: Roman Catholic basilica minor in Yamoussoukro, Ivory Coast
rows.hook: claims to be among the largest churches on Earth, with a dome inspired by Rome's St. Peter's

rows.label: Borobudur Temple
rows.description: Buddhist temple in Java, Indonesia
rows.hook: is a giant stepped stone monument decorated with hundreds of Buddha statues and carved panels

rows.label: Canterbury Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral in Canterbury, Kent, England, founded in 597
rows.hook: is where Thomas Becket was murdered, drawing pilgrims like those in Chaucer's tales

rows.label: Archbasilica of St. John Lateran
rows.description: cathedral in Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is the pope's own cathedral as Bishop of Rome, technically outranking St. Peter's

rows.label: Sainte Chapelle
rows.description: chapel in Paris, in France
rows.hook: is famed for walls of medieval stained glass and was built to house a crown of thorns

rows.label: Ulm Minster
rows.description: Gothic church in Germany
rows.hook: is topped by the tallest church spire in the world

rows.label: Saint Catherine Monastery
rows.description: Greek Orthodox monastery (the oldest) at the foot of Mount Sinai, Egypt
rows.hook: lies at the base of the mountain where Moses is said to have received the Ten Commandments

rows.label: Salisbury Cathedral
rows.description: church of England cathedral in Salisbury, England, UK
rows.hook: has the tallest church spire in Britain and keeps an original copy of Magna Carta

rows.label: St. Stephen's Cathedral
rows.description: church in Vienna, Austria
rows.hook: is topped by a steep roof of colorful zigzag tiles and a soaring Gothic spire

rows.label: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
rows.description: monastery and historical residence of the King of Spain
rows.hook: is a vast granite complex begun by Philip II, combining palace, library and a burial place for kings

rows.label: Basilica of Saint-Denis
rows.description: basilica located in Seine-Saint-Denis, in France
rows.hook: is the traditional burial place of kings and a birthplace of Gothic architecture

rows.label: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore
rows.description: largest Catholic Marian church in Rome
rows.hook: is said to stand where a miraculous August snowfall marked the site

rows.label: York Minster
rows.description: cathedral of York, North Yorkshire, England, UK
rows.hook: houses the largest medieval stained glass window in Britain, the Great East Window

rows.label: Cathedral of Our Lady of Strasbourg
rows.description: cathedral located in Bas-Rhin, in France
rows.hook: has a single asymmetric spire and was once the tallest building in the world

rows.label: Lotus Temple
rows.description: Bahá'í House of Worship in Delhi, India
rows.hook: is a white building shaped like a blooming flower that welcomes people of every religion

rows.label: St Mark's Basilica
rows.description: church in Venice, Italy
rows.hook: has glittering gold mosaics and faces a famous square often flooded by high tides

rows.label: Washington National Cathedral
rows.description: Neo-Gothic cathedral located in Washington, D.C.
rows.hook: is a Gothic-style landmark that hosts presidential funerals and has a Darth Vader gargoyle

rows.label: Seville Cathedral
rows.description: Catholic Cathedral in Seville (Formerly a Mosque), Spain
rows.hook: is among the biggest Gothic churches anywhere and holds the tomb of Christopher Columbus

rows.label: Umayyad Mosque
rows.description: mosque in Damascus, Syria
rows.hook: is one of history's oldest grand prayer halls and reputedly shelters the head of John the Baptist

rows.label: Notre-Dame de Chartres
rows.description: medieval Catholic cathedral in Chartres, France
rows.hook: is renowned for its exceptionally well-preserved medieval stained glass and a floor labyrinth

rows.label: Basilica of Saint Paul outside the Walls
rows.description: church in Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is built over the burial site of an apostle and displays portraits of every pope

rows.label: Pashupatinath Temple
rows.description: Hindu temple in Kathmandu
rows.hook: is a sacred riverside complex devoted to Shiva, where cremations take place on the banks

rows.label: Hallgrímskirkja
rows.description: church in Reykjavík, Iceland
rows.hook: has a striking concrete tower inspired by columns of basalt lava

rows.label: Winchester Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral in Winchester, Hampshire, England, UK
rows.hook: holds the grave of novelist Jane Austen and has one of the longest naves in Europe

rows.label: Reims Cathedral
rows.description: Roman Catholic cathedral of Reims in France
rows.hook: was the traditional site where the monarchs of its country were crowned for centuries

rows.label: St. Patrick's Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral of the Catholic Archdiocese of New York
rows.hook: is a Gothic Revival landmark on Fifth Avenue facing Rockefeller Center

rows.label: Rouen Cathedral
rows.description: cathedral located in Seine-Maritime, in France
rows.hook: was painted repeatedly by Claude Monet to capture changing light
